economy.summary: His campaign site says he will work for increased investment in communities and services for small businesses, will fight for a statewide minimum-wage increase so full-time jobs pay enough to support families, and supports expanding paid sick leave protections.
economy.short: Supports small-business investment, minimum-wage increase, expanded paid sick leave.

taxes.summary: Says he will fight for a more equitable tax system, proposing to close tax loopholes for corporations and the wealthy while making taxes more affordable for working- and middle-class families; supports shifting school funding away from property taxes and 'no budget, no pay' rules for legislators.
taxes.short: Proposes closing corporate loopholes; supports shifting school funding off property taxes.

abortion.summary: Co-sponsored House Bill 790 in March 2025, which would require hospitals with emergency departments to provide abortion services when necessary to stabilize patients with emergency medical conditions, and has said reproductive healthcare decisions should be made by patients with the guidance of their health providers, free from government overreach.
abortion.short: Co-sponsored emergency abortion-access bill; says patients, not government, should decide.

education.summary: Says the state must fund education at the state level and stop shifting the responsibility to homeowners through property taxes; calls investing in career and technical education a must and supports increased investment in state colleges to make higher education more affordable.
education.short: Says state must fund schools; supports career-technical and college investment.

healthcare.summary: Supports creating a public option for health insurance in Pennsylvania, says he will work to keep the costs of copays, services, and prescriptions down, supports caps on premiums, and pledges to pursue affordable long-term care options for seniors.
healthcare.short: Supports public insurance option; will work to lower copays, prescriptions.

energy.summary: Says he will advocate to transition away from fossil fuels through investments in green infrastructure and renewable energy sources like wind and solar, proposes an extraction tax on Marcellus Shale gas and removing state subsidies for the fossil fuel industry, and plans to phase out single-use plastics.
energy.short: Supports wind-solar transition; proposes Marcellus extraction tax, ending fossil subsidies.

guns.summary: Co-sponsored House Bill 714 of 2023, which requires background checks for private sales and transfers of long guns that were previously exempt; the bill passed the state House 109-92 in May 2023.
guns.short: Co-sponsored long-gun background-check bill that passed the House.
